content: सुवर्ण {%a.%} [शोभनो वर्णोऽस्य] .²1 Of good or beautiful colour, brilliant in hue, bright, yellow, golden. .²2 Of a good tribe or caste. .²3 Of good fame, glorious, celebrated. .{@-र्णः@} .²1 A good colour. .²2 A good tribe or caste. .²3 A sort of sacrifice. .²4 An epithet of Śiva. .²5 The thorn-apple. .{@-र्णा@} .²1 One of the seven tongues of fire. .²2 Black aloe-wood. .²3 Turmeric. .²4 Colocynth. .{@-र्णम्@} .²1 Gold. .²2 A golden coin. ({%m.%} also); नन्वहं दशसुवर्णान् प्रयच्छामि <ls>Mk. 2</ls>. .²3 A weight of gold equal to 16 Māṣas or about 175 grains Troy ({%m.%} also). .²4 Money, wealth, riches. .²5 A sort of yellow sandalwood. .²6 A kind of red chalk. .²7 <ab>N.</ab> of a tree (नागकेशर).
